tender.title: Global HRIS Integration Across 11 Countries
tender.raw_text: Meridian Consumer Goods Group is consolidating HR data for 4,200 employees across 11 countries. We operate SAP SuccessFactors for core HR, a third-party talent marketplace for contingent staffing, and four separate local payroll systems. We require an integration layer built on MuleSoft to unify these into a single employee record, with master data management so duplicate employees are not created across systems. Payroll interfaces must respect local statutory reporting formats. The integration must be deployed as versioned APIs and documented for our internal IT team, who will maintain it after handover.
requirements: MuleSoft integration layer unifying SuccessFactors, talent marketplace, and 4 local payroll systems
Master data management with cross-system duplicate employee prevention
Statutory payroll reporting formats per country
Versioned API layer with handover documentation to internal IT

Tech stack: MuleSoft, SAP SuccessFactors, Master Data Management.
